name: Color picker
summary: Pick a colour from a palette of presets.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-color-picker> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. A trigger swatch opens a persistent panel of preset colours (the brand ramp by default); open/close toggles the `open` attribute so the panel animates. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: panel fade + lift; swatch hover scale (ease-out)

whenToUse.when: choosing a brand or theme colour from a curated set
picking a labelled option rather than a colour
an arbitrary free-form value is genuinely needed

opinion.note: Prefer a curated palette over a free spectrum — on-brand results, fewer accessibility misses. Show the current value beside the trigger so the choice is legible.
opinion.dsv3: Trigger and panel use the standard border, radii and elevation; the selected swatch is ringed in color-primary. Panel fade + lift and swatch hover-scale animate on persistent nodes via the shared motion tokens.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe holds the default value #6A1EBB.
